description: Writes, debugs or extends code in a real language/runtime
environment: Docker sandbox with the language toolchain + test runner
l5_deliverable: Repository with source, tests and README

description: Writes SQL queries / DDL against a seeded database
hands_on_type: SQL queries / DDL (query language, not app code)
environment: Database engine container with seeded schema
auto_grading: Result-set / state comparison against answer key

description: Runs commands or native queries in a container; no application code
environment: Container shell with the tool installed, seeded state
l5_deliverable: Runbook + scripts + evidence of final state

description: Authors or repairs declarative config / IaC / pipeline files
environment: Linter, schema validator or dry-run in a container
auto_grading: Linter / schema / dry-run validation + behavioural probe

description: Analyses supplied artifacts (logs, traces, pcaps, datasets, reports) and submits structured answers
environment: Seeded files; Python/R/query tools available but optional
l5_deliverable: Analysis report with findings and recommendations

description: Works a guided, structured scenario for tools that cannot be sandboxed (SaaS, GUI, proprietary, GPU-only); no code
environment: No sandbox execution; structured form / ordering / decision-table / short answer
auto_grading: Decision key + rubric (BARS-style) on structured responses
